questions.q: According to the ideation stage guide, what is the biggest risk at this stage?
questions.why: The guide states the biggest risk during ideation is building the wrong thing, not building the thing wrong.

questions.q: What does the guide recommend about novelty when picking an idea and a stack?
options: Maximize novelty in both to stand out
Pick a stack you already know — novelty in the idea OR the stack, never both
Always use the newest framework available
Novelty doesn't matter at this stage
questions.why: The guide advises picking a stack you already know, since novelty should be limited to either the idea or the stack, not both.

questions.q: How many core entities should you sketch in the data model during ideation?
questions.why: The guide recommends listing the 3-5 core entities and how they relate.
